name: L03-fresh-retry1
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the in-chain parent scene — preserve its held set and existing composition, and take each held figure's STANCE and EXPRESSION (eye/brow/mouth) from its pixels — shape and register both — unless this request also seeds a pose or expression reference for that figure; a held face is inherited here, never re-invented and never re-read off the canonical. The SECOND image is the crowd exemplar — use its anonymous crowd proportion, face tier and the bounded 2-3 flat head-tone set it repeats; take nothing of its dress, period or setting, which each scene authors for itself.

The skylit mall keeps its curved concourse, sunken planter, oak kiosks, balcony rails, and buoyant shoppers across both levels. One blank cream computer carton now occupies the near kiosk, but beneath it sits an unmistakable, boldly rendered solid rust-red (#d7402b) square block shadow — dramatically oversized, several times larger and heavier than the small cream carton casting it, the single most eye-catching shape on the kiosk; only this changes; everything else exactly as established.

prompt_suffix: Clean flat 2.5D vector cartoon in The Second Take house style: even medium-thick dark warm brown-black (#241a12) outline on everything, flat cel colours with gentle soft shading, rounded friendly shapes, no realistic detail; any in-world lettering hand-lettered in the marker style, short and legible; warm-biased scene palette plus the single red accent #d7402b used only semantically (alarm / prohibition / ownership / the last punch element); no photorealism, no on-screen narrator or host face, no unrequested text, no logos; 16:9.

From the upper stair of an unbranded modern launch hall, a curved ramp descends around one black-glass smartphone on a cream platform below. Eager buyers — every single one drawn on the identical simplified flat crowd rig: dot eyes only, no nose, no ears, one simple mouth, at most three repeating hair silhouettes and at most three repeating flat head tones for the whole mass, never an individually detailed or realistic face — pack the ramp, gather behind the mezzanine rail, and press toward the single product anchor, while tall window bays and an open atrium keep the demand mass inside a much larger world; every wall, garment, barrier, and product surface is blank and unlettered.
